dedupe_keys.name: frecol educational toolbox for power system frequency control

description: FRECOL is an educational toolbox for long-term dynamic simulation of power system frequency control under realistic disturbance scenarios, built in MATLAB and Simulink. It was released in 2013 by I. M. Cecilio, Anne Mai Ersdal, Davide Fabozzi and Nina F. Thornhill with a paper at the IEEE PES Innovative Smart Grid Technologies Europe conference, and is archived on Zenodo with a PDF description. It is aimed at power and control engineering students, who can practise frequency control and test tuning and control strategies, and the paper gives a full description and examples. Coverage is not tied to a place. The toolbox is a zipped set of MATLAB and Simulink files, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: MATLAB and Simulink licences are needed, and the tool dates from 2013. Simulation uses are frequency stability after generation loss and testing load-frequency control and reserve strategies. Related records: model-issa-stability-analysis covers small-signal stability.
